en: Black-and-white image of a grand, empty ballroom or reception hall in ornate late Baroque/rococo style. The long room has a polished parquet floor, high decorated ceilings with elaborate stucco and gilded moldings, multiple large crystal chandeliers hanging in a row, and wall sconces with candelabra. Along the walls stand many upholstered chairs in a uniform style. There is an ornate fireplace with a mantel and bust, tall double doors with carved panels, and heavy curtains. The image is framed by a wide white border that is scuffed and worn, suggesting an old printed postcard or photographic card.
